runs.precision_family: B (FP4-packed storage, on-demand FP16 dequant, SM75 FP16 GEMV)

metrics.max_rel_error_exclusion_reason: mathematically undefined for near-zero reference element (ref ~1e-4, abs error ~0.004); catastrophic-cancellation artifact, not a semantic mismatch

runs.local_validation: 20/20 PASS (incl. external cross-checks of evidence copies vs pinned SHAs)
runs.notes: Correctness milestone only: one official routed expert executes on T4 and matches the trusted full-FP32 reference within predeclared tolerances. No TPS, no bitwise-exactness, no full-model/cache/one-T4 claims.

notes: Every accepted DeepSeek result must record: model revision, runtime SHA, harness SHA, hardware, GPU count, precision family, cache representation, prompt, reasoning effort, context length, generated tokens, base decode TPS, effective accepted TPS, DSpark acceptance, TTFT, TPOT, peak VRAM, process RSS, mapped bytes, expert-cache hit rate, H2D bytes, conversion time, kernel count, GPU busy percentage, exact/tolerance status, artifact hashes.
